title: fix(auth)!: with SSO-only mode on, an IdP-provisioned user is given no local password at any door; a platform administrator may still set their own
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoASGPj15PDYEW3irdvMYnjH)_

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowed: with SSO-only mode on (`ssoOnlyMode`, or `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY=true`), the four doors that write a local password, `POST /set-initial-password`, `POST /admin/set-user-password`, `POST /reset-password` and `POST /phone-number/reset-password`, answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` to a user whose `sys_user.source` is `idp_provisioned`, where they set the password; and the two reset doors answer `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when the reset record they would judge cannot be read. Widened: two public members, `AuthManager#isSsoOnlyMode()` (the read of the SSO-only switch the manager already resolves) and the optional `ssoOnlyMode?(): boolean` on `AdminUserEndpointDeps`. No first-party composition in this repository turns SSO-only mode on.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches SSO-only mode or these four doors; `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` gains the rule in this change, and `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx` names SSO-only mode only for the missing-credential log level, which does not move.

Part of #32087 (item 5, the server half under ruling record 6866334319: honour the SSO-only switch. The administrator's set-password warning and the governed ADR-0135 D5.2 note follow as their own work, and item 4 is its own pull request.)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:环境开了"仅 SSO 登录"(`ssoOnlyMode` / `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY`)时,服务端在四处会生成本地密码的入口(自设初始密码、管理员"设置密码"、邮件重置、短信重置)都拒绝给公司登录系统开通的员工(`idp_provisioned`)本地密码,回 409 并写明是"仅 SSO 模式";唯一例外是平台管理员给自己设应急密码。
- 为什么改:按你 11-13 对 #32087 第 5 项选的 D:兑现已有的"仅 SSO 登录"开关,开了就真的生效;spec 里 `ssoOnlyMode` 的描述同步写明服务端现在强制的规则。
- 风险与回滚:patch 级,但对**已经开着 SSO-only 的部署**是破坏性收紧(BREAKING):升级后,身份提供方开通的员工在这四处拿不到本地密码,改为走 SSO;平台管理员仍可给自己设应急密码。没开 SSO-only 的部署、本地(`env_native`)用户、云托管环境的规则都不变;已持有本地密码的员工照常用它登录和改密码(不追溯)。重置入口在读不到重置记录时拒绝(503),不放行。两处防锁死守卫没动。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-only-local-password.ts`(共用判定与重置入口的读法)、`auth-manager-before-hook.ts` 新增的重置入口分支、`admin-user-endpoints.ts` 的 set-user-password 分支。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-only-local-password.test.ts src/cloud-managed.test.ts src/password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts`,预期 81 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The rule.** With SSO-only mode on, the server gives a user whose `sys_user.source` is `idp_provisioned` no local password at any door that writes one without the user proving a current one. Each door answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (the registered code the cloud-managed refusals answer) with a message that names SSO-only mode, and writes nothing. One exception keeps break-glass reachable: a platform administrator setting their own local password.

| Door | SSO-only on, IdP-provisioned user | Exception (platform administrator, own password) | Predicate asked |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `POST /set-initial-password` | 409 | allowed | the session user's `isPlatformAdminUser` (the cloud-managed door's own) |
| `POST /admin/set-user-password` (`sys_user#set_user_password`) | 409, another administrator as target included | allowed when the target is the caller (the route's gate admits platform administrators only) | `actor.id === userId` behind `gateAdmin` |
| `POST /reset-password` (emailed link) | 409 | allowed | `isPlatformAdminUserId` (the manager's platform-admin standing) |
| `POST /phone-number/reset-password` (texted code) | 409 | allowed | `isPlatformAdminUserId` |

- `sso-only-local-password.ts` (new): the rule, its messages and refusal envelope, `readUserSource` (moved here from `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, the read the cloud-managed administrator door already asked, so both rules read one), the shared verdict `judgeSsoOnlyLocalPassword` (`allow` / `refuse` / `unreadable`, which fails closed as `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, as the cloud-managed door does), and `resolveResetDoorUserId`. The module header names both platform-administrator predicates, where they differ, and ADR-0135 D5.2's `env_native` stamp.
- The reset doors judge only a credential the door itself would accept, read without spending it: a live reset token, or a texted code that matches the live stored one inside its attempt budget (better-auth's own non-consuming predicate for that door). Any other request answers exactly as before. When the reset record (or the user it names) cannot be read, the reset doors fail closed with `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` instead of handing the request on unjudged.
- `admin-user-endpoints.ts`: the set-user-password arm after the cloud-managed arm; the deps take `ssoOnlyMode()`, read live per call.
- `auth-plugin.ts`: the set-initial-password arm after the cloud-managed arm; `adminUserDeps` passes `ssoOnlyMode`.
- `auth-manager-before-hook.ts`: the reset-door arm, ahead of the password complexity check so the refusal names the real reason. The host gains `getDataEngine` and `isSsoOnlyMode`.
- `auth-manager.ts`: `isSsoOnlyMode()`, the public read of the existing `resolveSsoOnly()`.
- `packages/spec` `AuthConfigSchema.ssoOnlyMode`: TSDoc and `.describe` say what the server now enforces; `content/docs/references/system/auth-config.mdx` regenerated. No key, value or export changes.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`: a short "SSO-only mode: IdP-provisioned users get no local password" section, including the fail-closed answer and which body shape each door answers.

**Unchanged:** SSO-only mode off; environment-native users (and rows with no source) at every door; a local password a user already holds (it still signs in, and `/change-password` still changes it); the cloud-managed rules, which answer first on a cloud-managed environment; `last-admin-guard.ts` and `last-local-credential.ts`. Not doors: `/change-password` (proves the current password), `/sign-up/email` (SSO-only already forces sign-up off), admin create-user and import-users (new rows only; import never changes an existing user's password), SCIM (writes no credential), the email-OTP reset (not mounted).

## Breaking

**BREAKING** for a deployment already running with SSO-only mode on: an IdP-provisioned user can no longer be given a local password at the four doors above; each answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` and writes nothing. Such a user signs in through the identity provider; a platform administrator can still set their own break-glass password; a deployment that needs a managed user to hold a local password turns SSO-only mode off. Level stays `patch` (a non-protocol change; AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3). The widening is two additive public members: `AuthManager#isSsoOnlyMode()` and the optional `AdminUserEndpointDeps.ssoOnlyMode?()`. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset: no schema key, value or type moves, and nothing stored needs a migration.

## Why

Ruling record 6866334319 on #32087, item 5 → D: when SSO-only mode is on, the server refuses to give an IdP-provisioned user a local password at every door, with the one break-glass exception the cloud-hosted rule already makes; SSO-only off is unchanged; not retroactive.

## Tests

- `sso-only-local-password.test.ts` (new, the module's own pins): the verdict table (off reads nothing; refuse; the platform-administrator exception; environment-native and source-less rows ask no standing; fail closed on no engine, no read surface, a throwing read); the refusal envelope and that its code and status equal the cloud-managed ones; `resolveResetDoorUserId` names a user only for a live token or a matching in-budget code, reads nothing on another path, and answers unreadable when the reset record or the user lookup has no read surface or throws.
- `cloud-managed.test.ts` (the set doors' shared harness, a real `AuthManager` behind `registerAuthRoutes` on Hono), new top-level describe: per door, SSO-only on refuses the IdP-provisioned user with 409 + code + sentence and writes no credential; the IdP-provisioned platform administrator setting their own is allowed; an administrator setting one for another IdP-provisioned administrator is refused; an environment-native user and an anonymous caller answer as before; SSO-only off answers as before (CONTROL); on a cloud-managed environment the cloud-managed refusal answers. Not retroactive: an IdP-provisioned user holding a password still signs in and changes it, while no door sets it anew.
  - The existing leg "unmanaged with SSO-only on, both doors answer the idp user as before" pinned the behaviour this ruling reverses. It now asserts that the SSO-only refusal answers there, never the cloud-managed sentence, and a new leg keeps the SSO-only-off control.
- `password-reset-ends-sessions.test.ts` (the reset doors' shared harness, a real ObjectQL on SQLite), new top-level describe: for each reset door, SSO-only on refuses the IdP-provisioned user (409 + code + sentence, no credential written); a holder is refused too and their password still signs in; the platform administrator resetting their own is allowed; an environment-native user answers as before; an unmatched token or a wrong code answers exactly as it does with SSO-only off; a reset record that cannot be read (every `sys_verification` read made to throw) answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and writes no credential; SSO-only off resets as before (CONTROL).

## Acceptance notes

- Reading confirmed by the seat before the edit: the set and reset doors refuse an IdP-provisioned user even when one already holds a password (the cloud-managed administrator door does the same); "not retroactive" means an existing password keeps working.
- The reset-door refusal leaves in better-auth's flat `{ code, message }` body, the shape those doors' other refusals (`INVALID_TOKEN`, `INVALID_OTP`) take; the set doors answer the nested ADR-0112 envelope, as their cloud-managed refusals do.
- The cloud mounts its own twin of `set-initial-password` from `runSetInitialPassword`; this PR puts the SSO-only arm in this repository's route, as the cloud-managed arm is, and a cloud-managed environment answers the stricter cloud-managed rule first.
- Contract review 6868317289 (FAIL at `f3393c48`, must-fix ②): this head declares the narrowing and the widening, adds `!`, the BREAKING banner, the ADR-0087 disposition and the `Skills-docs:` line, and runs the dogfood battery. Nits 2, 3 and 5 are taken as prose (module header, `authentication.mdx`). Nit 4 (the request-reset doors still send a mail or text to a user whose reset will be refused) is not in the ruling and is left for the seat.
- Remainders, not in this PR: the administrator's set-password warning (ui card), the governed ADR-0135 D5.2 note (kept in step with cloud ADR-0024 D5.2), and the question of managed users who already hold a local password.
